title: Final Force Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct final expression for the force F(r).

title: Potential Function Derivation
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly derive the potential function V(r) from the Schrödinger equation.

title: Wave Function Relation
description: Important Criteria: The student must demonstrate understanding of the relationship between wave functions in coordinate and momentum space.

title: Gradient Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly compute the gradient of the potential to find the force.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that the units of the force are consistent with the physical context.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common errors such as sign mistakes in the force calculation.
